implementation.binding: The hosted job source is the code head; the clean macOS checkout has the same selected-input digest and differs only by documentation.

macos.environment: macOS 27.2.1 (26B131), AppleClang 21, ARM64, Release; clean shared/static builds with tests and documentation disabled

checks: All six shared/static probe receipts report ABI version 2 rejected, version 3 accepted, matching relocated files and the expected installed target.
All three shared probes bind loaded runtime path/hash to the selected target and execute the relocated dwg2dxf usage path. The static probes build relocated consumers.

Local verification compared each receipt's selected target to its installed-file hash, checked shared runtime identity, and recorded receipt and GitHub artifact digests. The local shared dylib is ARM64.
limits: This closes package selection, installation, relocation and minimal runtime identity for the stated platforms and digest; it does not establish the complete C++ ABI, drawing semantics, GUI or FreeCAD support.
The hosted workflow overall did not pass: its macOS leg was cancelled and is replaced only for this package profile by the independently run local macOS probe.
Reopen the package gates when selected source inputs, configuration, probes, or platform/toolchain requirements change.
